title: TenancyMembershipCreatedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.membership.created` version 1: a user became a member of a partner, as its creator and first owner or by accepting an invitation. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner the user joined, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

user_id.description: The user who became a member.

role.description: The role of the new membership.
